manual_required: A1 - Activation is silent: verifying a clean activation request requires deactivating then reactivating both plugins. This task's hard constraints explicitly prohibit deactivating either plugin in combo mode, so A1 cannot be exercised without violating that constraint. Not attempted. (A2 schema-in-place and A5 lockstep were verified directly against the live install: 37 wp_wbam_* tables present, wbam_db_version=1.7.0 and wbam_pro_db_version=4.2.0 both set, WBAM_VERSION === WBAM_PRO_VERSION === 3.1.0.)

B1 - Migration is silent, data intact: no prior-tag build of wb-ads-rotator-with-split-test / wb-ad-manager-pro exists in this environment to install and then upgrade from. A literal version-to-version upgrade could not be performed. (B2's core mechanism -- one-time backfill draining fully under load without looping -- was independently verified live via the D7 fixture: 260 typeless ads seeded, backfill option cleared, Video_Ad_Resolver::maybe_backfill_type_meta() invoked directly, drained 260 -> 0 typeless ads in a single call using 1,305 queries in 0.078s, flag set afterward, no second pass required. Counted as B2 pass.)

F - Cross-browser spot pass (Firefox, Safari iOS): the Playwright MCP tooling available in this environment drives a single Chromium/Chrome instance and exposes no Firefox or WebKit/Safari channel to switch to. Full coverage on Chrome (desktop 1440px and mobile 390px, light and dark) was completed across the C/D/S checks in this report; Firefox and Safari iOS specifically could not be exercised.
